data.narrative:
Sorcerer is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Austin Tindle, Maxmillion McLaughlin, and Alessandro Vecchi. The company has raised $3.9M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 8 private peers (such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix) and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though none of these peers occupy the same stage or valuation tier as Sorcerer, limiting direct peer-median benchmarking.

The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $3.9M raised, a standard step-up from Seed to the next funding round. This implies a valuation of $9.75M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the Climate & Energy universe—zero narrow-filtered comparables met the threshold of three or more observations, and a cross-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $11M, with a median of $10M. This range reflects a single reliable method and therefore carries material uncertainty. Key dependencies include the actual terms and pricing of the most recent round, which would anchor valuation more precisely, and the company's progress against operational milestones before Series A fundraising. The sparse peer set in this stage-sector combination underscores execution risk as the primary driver of future value creation.
